events.summary: Jedit tries to unite the cat warrior tribes against Johan; the Sulaki refuse to ally with non-worshippers of Ergerborg.
events.quote: the Sulaki first refused to ally with anyone not worshiping Ergerborg

events.summary: Jedit uses a skyship to uproot the giant brown stone symbolizing Ergerborg.
events.quote: Jedit used the skyship of the Robaran Mercenaries to uproot the giant brown-stone and cast it to the side

events.summary: The Sulaki become the first cat warrior tribe to ally with the humans and Efravans.
events.quote: the Sulaki were the first cat warrior tribe to officially ally with the humans and Efravans
